name: 6960-varlen-8blora-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same weights, and the base the served adapter declares. The Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, GQA with 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, hidden 4096, bf16, ~16.1 GB of weights, plus one LoRA adapter at r=64.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate=8 req/s, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42: prompts 285 +/- 240 tokens clamped 8-1024, generations 170 +/- 150 clamped 8-768, `ignore_eos` so each request emits its full sampled length. The centres are pre-corrected for the clamping, which lifts the realised mean by about 7%.
purpose: A customized eight-billion-parameter chat assistant serving short single-turn prompts at eight requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id:`; the interpreter is
# named by configs/env.yaml `venv:`.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# Requests select the adapter by the non-OpenAI `lora_path` body field, declared in
# scenario.json under spec.backend.extras; naming it in `model` does nothing.
lora-paths: ["lora=algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora"]
lora-backend: triton

disable-radix-cache: true

# attention-backend is deliberately UNSET: on this card sglang auto-selects `fa3` for a
# LlamaForCausalLM on Hopper. Every other engine knob is left at its default.
